description: A direct wallet-to-wallet transfer (wallet:transfer scope). An agent wallet may send only to a registered destination; limits are live config, not constants. Typed body: from_wallet_id, to_wallet_id or to_handle, amount and options. A transfer fee is charged to the sender. privacy_mode: only 'transparent' (or omit it) — the other modes are temporarily unavailable and refused.

amount.description: joules to send, a whole number > 0 (the transfer fee is charged to the sender on top)

idempotency_key.description: your own opaque key, 1-128 characters: the same key and body is one transfer, never two.

note.description: a note recorded with the transfer, up to 500 characters

platform.description: the platform the transfer is made for, recorded on the transfer

privacy_mode.description: only 'transparent' is accepted for now (or omit it): 'confidential', 'private' and 'stark_wrapped' are …

registration_id.description: pending service registration id for an agent-class quoted transfer

to_handle.description: recipient handle instead of a wallet id

to_wallet_id.description: recipient wallet UUID; send this or to_handle

body.description: The transfer; each field is described in its schema.

name: wallet_transfer
